title: The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all…
description: The Tutor LMS WordPress plugin up to version 4.2.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can delete any comment they authored anywhere on the site, including lesson and post comments, as well as all replies to those comments authored by any user, including administrators and instructors.
